description: This file contains unit tests for the VoicePushToTalkHotkey component, testing that begin and end actions fire correctly upon modifier state changes.

classes.name: Counter
classes.description: A helper actor class to count how many times begin and end actions are invoked within the test.

methods.name: incBegin
methods.description: Increments the began counter, indicating the start of voice push-to-talk.

methods.name: incEnd
methods.description: Increments the ended counter, indicating the end of voice push-to-talk.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns the current count of began and ended events.
